items.t: Oil sludge leading to engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured 2.7L
items.note: Owners report $3,000–$6,000.

items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace water pump (timing cover removal), often with timing chain parts
items.note: If coolant has damaged the bearings, the engine may need replacing.

items.t: Timing chain stretch or breakage
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioners
items.note: Owners report about $3,700 on average, often including other engine damage.

items.t: Head gasket leaks
items.job: Replace head gasket and resurface cylinder head

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failure
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners report about $2,000 on average.

items.t: Engine stalls while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; commonly a sensor, wiring or fuel repair
items.note: Owners report about $660 on average.

items.t: Timing belt failure if replacement is overdue
items.job: Replace timing belt and tensioner
items.note: Water pump and pulleys add cost. Valve damage after a snapped belt costs much more.

items.t: Engine oil leaks
items.job: Replace leaking gasket or seal
items.note: Owners report about $800 on average.

items.t: Blower fan only works on high
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor

items.t: Temperature control knob breaks
items.job: Replace HVAC temperature control
items.note: Owners report about $700 on average.

items.t: Dashboard curls up under the windshield
items.job: Replace dashboard top pad
items.note: A molded dash cover costs far less.
